bg-irr-02-01.h: Irregular ㄷ Verbs (ㄷ shifts to ㄹ)

bg-irr-02-01.hint: Before a vowel ending (-었어요), ㄷ in 듣다 transforms into ㄹ → 들었어요.
bg-irr-02-01.why: 듣다 is a ㄷ-irregular verb, changing to 들었어요 in the past tense.

bg-irr-02-01.hint: Before a vowel ending, ㄷ in 걷다 changes to ㄹ → 걸었어요.
bg-irr-02-01.why: 걷다 is irregular before vowel endings, conjugating into 걸었어요.
듣다 shifts ㄷ to ㄹ before vowel ending -어요 → 들어요.

bg-irr-02-01.q: State that you listen to music every day. Use 저 + topic particle -는, adverb 매일, 음악 + object particle -을, and ㄷ irregular verb 듣다 in the polite present (-아요/어요).
bg-irr-02-01.why: 듣다 conjugates into 들어요 in the polite present.

items: Conjugate ㄷ-irregular verbs like 듣다 and 걷다 before vowels
Distinguish irregular ㄷ verbs from regular ㄷ verbs like 받다 and 닫다

bg-irr-02-02.hint: 르 verbs drop ㅡ and add an extra ㄹ beneath the preceding syllable: 모르다 → 몰라요.
bg-irr-02-02.why: In 르-irregular verbs, 르 becomes double ㄹ: 모르- + -아요 → 몰라요.

bg-irr-02-02.hint: 빠르다 inserts an extra ㄹ into the first syllable: 빠르다 → 빨라요.
bg-irr-02-02.why: 르 doubles into ㄹㄹ: 빠르- + -아요 → 빨라요.
빠르다 conjugates to 빨라요 with doubled ㄹ.

bg-irr-02-02.q: State that you do not know the answer. Use 저 + topic particle -는, 답 + object particle -을, and 르 irregular verb 모르다 in the polite present (-아요/어요).

items: Drop ㅡ and insert a supporting ㄹ when conjugating 르 verbs
Conjugate common 르 verbs like 모르다 and 빠르다 into 해요 form

bg-irr-02-03.hint: The vowel in 부 is ㅜ (dark vowel), so it takes -러요, not -라요: 불러요.
bg-irr-02-03.why: 부르다 has the dark vowel ㅜ, requiring vowel harmony with -러요 → 불러요.

bg-irr-02-03.hint: 누르다 doubles the ㄹ and takes -러요: 눌러요.
bg-irr-02-03.why: 누르다 is a 르-irregular verb, doubling ㄹ with vowel ㅜ taking -러요 → 눌러요.

bg-irr-02-03.hint: I sing a song with my friend.
bg-irr-02-03.why: 부르다 doubles ㄹ and takes -러요 → 불러요.

bg-irr-02-03.q: State that you press the elevator button. Use compound noun 엘리베이터 버튼 + object particle -을 and 르 irregular verb 누르다 in the polite present (-아요/어요).

items: Apply vowel harmony to 르 verbs: -라요 for ㅏ/ㅗ stems and -러요 for others
Conjugate dark vowel 르 verbs such as 부르다 and 누르다 accurately

bg-irr-02-04.h: Plain ㅡ Drop Verbs (No Double ㄹ)

bg-irr-02-04.hint: 아프다 is a plain ㅡ drop verb, not a 르 verb! Simply drop ㅡ: 아프- → 아파요.
bg-irr-02-04.why: 아프다 ends in ㅍ+ㅡ, which simply drops ㅡ without inserting extra ㄹ: 아파요.

bg-irr-02-04.hint: 다르다 is a 르-irregular verb, doubling the ㄹ: 달라요.
bg-irr-02-04.why: 다르다 requires an extra supporting ㄹ before vowel endings: 달라요.

bg-irr-02-04.hint: I turn off the light in the room.
bg-irr-02-04.why: 끄다 is a plain ㅡ drop verb, conjugating directly into 꺼요.

bg-irr-02-04.q: State that two people's personalities are different from each other. Use phrase 두 사람 + topic particle -은, 성격 + subject particle -이, adverb 서로, and 르 irregular adjective 다르다 in the polite present (-아요/어요).
bg-irr-02-04.why: 다르다 doubles the consonant ㄹ to become 달라요.

items: Differentiate 르-irregular verbs from regular ㅡ-drop verbs like 아프다 and 끄다
Avoid mistakenly adding extra ㄹ to plain ㅡ-drop stems
